{{Quote|They're telling us all to leave.|Bureau of Standards employee telling Syril Karn about the ISB raid|<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />}} 
A [[human]] '''employee''' of the [[Imperial Bureau of Standards]] that worked at it's [[Bureau of Standards Ghorman field office|field office]] on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] in [[3 BBY]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> They were at the field office when the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] conducted a search for [[listening device]] in the office. As part of the raid the ISB agents instructed them all to leave, when asked about it the employee informed their boss, Syril Karn, as such. They had light skin, [[color|blue]] [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]]. While working at the field office they wore a dark grey [[clothing|vest]] over a grey high collared shirt with matching dark grey pants and a black tie.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
The employee appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's fourth episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The employee was portrayed [[Freddie Meredith]] and listed in the series' credits as simply "BOS #2".<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />
